items.html: And let us return to the matter: for now, at the time of the Shema upon the bed, since he has only one level alone of the three aforementioned levels, which is the encircling ones of Ima, therefore he has no power to draw except from the externality of Aba and Ima alone; and therefore only the Mochin of the VAK of Gadlut from the side of Ima enter into him, and no more, as will be said with the help of God. And therefore also that coupling is inferior, and it is Jacob and Leah, while they are only below the chest.
